julesThoughtProcess: Cyan (#00FFFF) provides a bright, high-tech glow, suiting the atmospheric and hopeful slice of life tone in this technofuturistic world.
storyPanel: The neon-cyan glow of the neighborhood synthesizer terminal flickers, illuminating tired but resilient faces. Here, a retired maintenance bot shares its power reserves with a local mechanic's toolkit. It's a small, quiet moment of connection amidst the humming metropolis, a reminder that even in a world of circuits and steel, community keeps the lights on.
